claims.text: On DEBRIEFED with Chris Ramsay, 22 May 2026, at 0:09:40, host Chris Ramsay, attributing the account to the Puerto Rican researcher Jorge Martin, said that the FAA confirmed the deployment of multiple F-14s 'for testing' near Cabo Rojo at the time of a December 1988 mass sighting, and that the Americans later denied it. No record opened here bears on that claim.
